zh: 仓库里 36 段登记在册的复制代码全部清零：分段控件的大小两种造型收进共享样式表 shared/segment-control.css（视图切换与工作区切换不再各抄一份，权限与设置的分段控件也回到真正的共享层），品牌图的蒙版写法由 shared/masked.css 单源化，弹层暗色卡片、幽灵按钮、表单控件盒型、渐变褪色带等重复声明各自合并，脚本与测试工具的公共启动代码收进 scripts/shared/ 与 packages/testing/。jscpd 基线文件随之删除，lint 现在对任何新复制段直接拒绝。页面外观与行为不变。
en: The 36 tracked copied stretches are gone: the two segment-control looks live in the shared sheet shared/segment-control.css (the view tabs and the workspace switch no longer carry their own copies, and the permission and settings controls return to a genuinely shared layer), the masked brand-mark idiom is single-sourced in shared/masked.css, the dark popover card, ghost buttons, form-control boxes and the fade ramp are each merged to one rule, and the scripts' and testing tools' shared bootstrap moved into scripts/shared/ and packages/testing/. The jscpd baseline file is deleted with them; lint now refuses any new copied stretch. Page look and behavior are unchanged.
